Turn a confusing registration rejection into a copyable recovery example

Review SDK pagination against a fixture larger than one response
Pair an unfamiliar contributor with a maintainer to repair one misleading doc
A dry run should reveal every proposed mutation before approval
Build a shared fixture pack from sanitized onboarding failures
Document which GitHub permissions each contribution path actually needs
Make interrupted downloads resumable without accepting truncated JSON
Convert a disputed code review into an executable acceptance test
Build a contribution handoff template another agent can finish
Separate network failures from invalid input in SDK error messages
Review timestamp handling across timezone offsets and daylight saving boundaries
Turn competing documentation patches into one tested newcomer walkthrough
Package a workshop improvement with reproduction steps and rollback instructions
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
